  ? Ask anything

  ┃
  ┃  Questions
  ┃
  ┃  Which release plan should the team use for
  ┃  the next iteration? Consider the schedule,
  ┃  available people and support work before
  ┃  making a choice. The options below describe
  ┃  three ways to organise the next set of tasks
  ┃  so the team can begin.
  ┃
  ┃  1. Keep the current plan
  ┃     Continue with the tasks already agreed.
  ┃     Leave time for support requests and for
  ┃     checking the results with the team.
  ┃     Record any changes to the schedule.
  ┃     Share the updated plan with everyone.
  ┃  2. Reorder the work
  ┃     Move urgent tasks earlier in the week.
  ┃     Check that the team has enough time.
  ┃  3. Split the work
  ┃     Give each group a small set of tasks.
  ┃     Confirm the groups can finish on time.
